caption: The drawing depicts a circular arrangement of various flowers and leaves forming a wreath on a dark, almost black background. The flowers are illustrated in a range of colors, including shades of pink, red, yellow, white, purple, and blue. Green leaves of varying sizes and shapes are interspersed among the flowers, adding to the fullness of the wreath. Larger flowers, such as prominent red and yellow blooms, alternate around the wreath with smaller flowers in colors like blue, white, and purple. Some of the flowers are depicted in clusters, while others are solitary, and several flower buds are visible along with the open blossoms. The color application is vivid and detailed, with pastel or pencil-like textures and shading used to highlight the contours of petals and leaves. The composition is balanced, with the floral elements evenly distributed around the circular form, allowing the black background to show through the center and between the plant elements. The wreath is centered within a pale, rectangular border that frames the entire drawing.
title: Crewel Work Wreath
